definitions.started_in_game_injury: Fantasy starter, documented injury-related exit, and confirmed missed NFL game snaps.
definitions.rotation_injury: Started >=2 of prior 4 completed fantasy weeks for this manager; meaningful verified injury even if benched this week.
definitions.major_rotation_injury: Rotation injury resulting in >=4 NFL games missed, injured reserve or season-ending absence, supported by evidence.
definitions.non_additive: A single injury may qualify for multiple categories; do not sum category totals.
